jp_stipendio_regola.frammento: The JET participant's salary is determined by the number of years of participation on the JET Program.

jp_trattenute.frammento: In Japan, joining the national social (health) insurance, contributing to the pension fund program and paying employment insurance are mandatory. A part of these costs are borne by the participant and deducted from the monthly post-tax remuneration each month on payday.

jp_ore.frammento: Participants are expected to be at work approximately thirty-five hours a week, excluding lunch breaks.

jp_durata.frammento: The 2026 JET contract is for roughly 12 months and commences on the day after the designated arrival date.

jp_rinnovo.frammento: The contracting organization may reappoint the JET participant for an additional one-year contract, with a maximum of five years total.

jp_ferie.frammento: The amount of paid leave per year differs among contracting organizations, but all participants are guaranteed to have at least ten days.

jp_altro_lavoro.frammento: Participants are prohibited from taking on any work other than that of this Program for the duration of their appointment.

jp_visto.frammento: The JET Program Office will provide the necessary work visa for candidates who are selected to participate on the JET Program.
